name: ttyglass
description: Observe and debug real terminal user interfaces in a local browser.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.ts && nub --filter @ttyglass/frontend run build && nub --filter @ttyglass/docs run build && node scripts/build-native.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: node scripts/verify-vendor.ts && nub --filter @ttyglass/frontend run check && nub --filter @ttyglass/docs run check && biome check src test tests scripts apps/docs/src/data apps/docs/src/styles && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && nimble check && nimble c --compileOnly --path:src test/test_diagnostics.nim && nimble c --compileOnly --path:src test/test_ipc.nim && nimble c --compileOnly --path:src test/test_terminal_screen.nim
scripts.format: nub --filter @ttyglass/frontend run format && biome format --write src test tests scripts apps/docs/src/data apps/docs/src/styles
scripts.package:check: nub run check && nub run test && node scripts/verify-package.ts
scripts.test: nimble c -r --path:src --nimcache:.local/nimcache/test-diagnostics --out:.local/test-diagnostics test/test_diagnostics.nim && nimble c -r --path:src --nimcache:.local/nimcache/test-ipc --out:.local/test-ipc test/test_ipc.nim && nimble c -r --path:src --nimcache:.local/nimcache/test-terminal-screen --out:.local/test-terminal-screen test/test_terminal_screen.nim && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts
